_menu_doc: a worker's two build pages (Dominic: civilian and military apart), each in the order its buttons appear (building hotkeys work from either page; hotkeys are avoided where they clash with WASD panning and the debug keys)
_tree_doc: the tech tree page's columns, left to right (scenes/tech_tree.gd); a building missing here goes after these, by age. Buildings with "status": "planned" are drawn on the page as blank frames and skipped by the sim, the build menus and the art bakes (milestone 12)
_walls_doc: "line": placed by dragging a line of tiles (walls); "gate": blocks like a wall but its owner's team walks through it; "length": a gate's footprint is length x size, turned to run along sim x or sim y (chosen at placement, from the wall under it); "replaces": building types of your own it may be dropped on, taking their place (a gate into a wall line)
_age_looks_doc: per architecture and building type, the model it takes from an age on, e.g. {"junk": {"town_center": {"3": "concept_junk_tc_pride"}}}: a culture's buildings grow with the ages. Empty until Dominic picks (concept rounds RB3 and on)
_scale_doc: a culture's own size for a building type (Dominic: the rats' house and barracks, smaller, D-090)
_variants_doc: how many looks a type bakes (turned a quarter round, nudged in size); each building picks one, like rocks

archery_range.name: Archery Range
archery_range.desc: Trains your ranged soldiers: skirmishers, who hunt archers, and archers.

armoury.name: Armoury
armoury.desc: Where weapons and armour are improved: sharper points, better bows, tougher kit.
armoury.note: weapon and armour research (Sharp Sticks moved here, Dominic)

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Trains your spearmen, the line that holds against riders and big beasts.
barracks.note: infantry (the spear line); the Archery Range and Stable train the rest

farm.name: Farm
farm.desc: A field of food that workers tend without walking far. When it's worked out it lies fallow; reseed it for wood.
farm.note: when built, its ground becomes crops (a rice paddy in water, for amphibians): one farm, one pool of food; worked out it lies fallow, and a worker can reseed it for wood

house.name: House
house.desc: Room for more of your people. Every unit needs space; without houses, training stops.

lumber_camp.name: Lumber Camp
lumber_camp.desc: A place to drop wood close to where it's cut. Woodcutting research is done here.

market.name: Market
market.desc: Buy and sell food, wood and stone for gold. Prices move with what everyone trades.
market.note: trade: buy/sell with gold, shared prices

mill.name: Mill
mill.desc: A place to drop food near bushes and farms. Foraging and farming research is done here.

mining_camp.name: Mining Camp
mining_camp.desc: A place to drop stone and gold close to the deposits. Mining research is done here.

stable.name: Stable
stable.desc: Trains your large unit: a rider, a giant or a heavy, whatever your race fields.
stable.note: the large unit (mounts, giants or heavies)

town_center.name: Town Center
town_center.desc: The heart of your town: trains workers, takes in every resource, and is where you age up. Lose it and you lose.

wall.name: Stone Wall
wall.desc: A stone wall, one tile at a time: drag to lay a line. Stops anyone who can't fly; put a Stone Gate in it to let your own side through.
wall.note: dragged in lines; flyers go over

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.desc: A lookout that shoots the nearest enemy in range and sees far into the fog.
watchtower.note: shoots the nearest enemy in range

palisade.name: Palisade Wall
palisade.desc: A wall of sharpened stakes, one tile at a time: drag to lay a line. Cheap and quick, but it won't hold for long. Flyers go over.
palisade.note: dragged in lines; the age-1 wall

palisade_gate.name: Palisade Gate
palisade_gate.desc: A stake gate three tiles long: drop it on your palisade and it follows the line (on open ground, R turns it). It opens for your side and stays shut to everyone else.

stone_gate.name: Stone Gate
stone_gate.desc: A stone gatehouse three tiles long: drop it on your stone wall and it follows the line (on open ground, R turns it). It opens for your side and stays shut to everyone else.

outpost.name: Outpost
outpost.desc: A cheap lookout post: it sees far but doesn't shoot.

siege_workshop.name: Siege Workshop
siege_workshop.desc: Builds siege engines: rams, catapults, bolt throwers and siege towers.

university.name: University
university.desc: Research for buildings, towers and siege: stronger walls, taller towers, longer reach.

temple.name: Temple
temple.desc: Trains mystics, who heal and win enemies over, and researches their lore.

castle.name: Castle
castle.desc: A fortress that shoots and shelters: trains the race's own unique unit, sappers and the great sling, and holds its own research.

wonder.name: Wonder
wonder.desc: A great work of your people. Build it and keep it standing long enough, and you win.
